premises.text: Humanity needs ~60% more agricultural output while climate-related crop failures rise, creating urgent unmet need for new resilient crop varieties
premises.evidence_span: We have an urgent and unmet need to deliver new and resilient crop varieties to farmers

premises.text: GWAS discovery is mostly not useful (~14%, sometimes 1%), and GMO or traditional breeding then takes years and up to $100M
premises.evidence_span: only about 14% of the things that they return are actually useful, and sometimes it's as low as 1%

premises.text: Interpretable machine-learning discovery identifies causal gene targets at about 90% precision
premises.evidence_span: allows us to identify causal gene targets with 90% precision

premises.text: An AI recommendation system suggests plant crosses that produce desired traits using about a hundredth of the usual data and forecasts outcomes before breeding
premises.evidence_span: an AI-enabled recommendation system that suggests which plant crosses might produce the traits that we're looking for. And it does that with only a hundredth of the data that's normally required

premises.text: Cost and time efficiency make any crop economically feasible, so Avalo enters partners' breeding pipelines and builds its own new seed products
premises.evidence_span: we can actually work on any crop in the world. So even crops that were too complicated or too costly to work on are now economically feasible for us

domains.name: Urgent resilient-crop need and discovery bottleneck
Interpretable ML discovery and cross recommendations
Any-crop economics and partner seed pipelines

value.text: Accelerate creation of new productive, climate-resilient crop varieties for farmers
value.evidence_span: accelerate the creation of new and productive crop varieties

secondary_value.text: Enable a more sustainable and resilient agricultural future
secondary_value.evidence_span: a more sustainable and resilient world is still possible

causal_links.evidence_span: urgent and unmet need to deliver new and resilient crop varieties
increase the process of discovery and development by up to 77%
get our technology into their existing breeding pipelines so that they can reap the time and cost advantages

notes: Team bios and Duke collaboration excluded. Broccoli experiment treated as validation of the recommendation mechanism, not a separate premise. Greener-tomorrow closing treated as vision/secondary. Singleton D3 retained: partner/own-seed go-to-market is revisable without changing the ML stack. Partition is need/tech/GTM triad; justified because pipeline partnership economics can fail while discovery precision still holds.
